enhanced_resume.name: ALEX MORGAN
enhanced_resume.summary: Backend engineer with 6 years of experience designing and scaling Python-based services, REST APIs, and cloud infrastructure on AWS. Experienced in decomposing monolithic applications into services, tuning PostgreSQL and MySQL performance, and building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker. AWS Certified Developer and Docker Certified Associate who mentors teammates and drives code-review and testing standards. Seeking a Senior Backend Engineer role focused on scalable, distributed cloud platform systems.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
bullets: Designed, built, and maintained high-throughput REST APIs in Python serving over 50,000 active users, collaborating with Product and Frontend teams to define API contracts
Led incremental migration of a monolithic application into smaller, independently deployable services, improving scalability and deployment velocity
Optimized database performance by redesigning indexes and rewriting slow queries, cutting average query response time and reducing production load
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker, automating test and deployment workflows to improve release reliability
Mentored 3 new engineers through onboarding and conducted thorough code reviews, raising overall code quality and team throughput

experience.title: Junior Developer
bullets: Developed customer-facing e-commerce features using React and Node.js, delivering production functionality in an Agile, cross-functional team
Integrated third-party payment APIs including Stripe and PayPal, ensuring secure and reliable transaction processing
Maintained MySQL databases and authored migration scripts to support schema evolution with zero data loss
Diagnosed and resolved production bugs and support tickets, strengthening system stability and incident response skills
